bridge_classification_notes: Goodwill, PP&E and residual operating assets remain in operating enterprise value; not added again.
Operating leases remain in EBIT and FCFF; operating lease assets/liabilities are not separately bridged. Finance leases are included in debt once.
Qualified pension surplus of 231 is not treated as freely distributable excess cash; no separate addition under restricted-surplus convention.
Operating payables, employee/insurance reserves, deferred occupancy and operating deferred taxes remain embedded in continuing operating economics; not an extra financing deduction.
Dividends payable are distributions to the same common owners; not an additional non-common claim in this cum-distribution equity value.
No preferred equity or noncontrolling interest is shown in Target consolidated statements; zero separate claim is an evidenced classification, not an unexplained missing value.
The bridge is specified under explicit carrying-value/classification assumptions; unreported cutoff balances, award dilution and fair-value differences remain estimation risks.

Current/noncurrent income-tax accruals are treated as continuing operating tax float under the constant-balance/cash-operating-tax convention. Do not deduct them again as financing debt. A separate 780 immediate-settlement stress can test cessation of that float; it is not the base convention.
